notes.title: Japanese localization and Wishlists
notes.notes:
Dear Japanese fans!
We are glad to present you Japanese localization.

We also thank everyone else from the bottom of our hearts for adding to the wishlists! Your support for the best of everything else helps us make the game even better and more interesting.

Best regards, Rocket Games
